data.content_ref: inline:The proposed abstraction is under-specified as a genuine relation because 'REFUTED IF' is attached to a condition (clean in-distribution mapping) that does not discriminate the abstraction claim from the original stratification claim. If the competence/compliance gap can persist even on clean, non-adversarial items, then the 'special case of adversarial perturbation' framing is not an abstraction but a mislabeling of an ordinary partition as adversarial. The refutation condition is stated but no criterion is given for when clean in-distribution behavior would still be consistent with the adversarial abstraction, so the relation reduces to renaming the same partition rather than establishing a substantive abstraction link.
